claim: NullPropagatedOperands recurses into every SqlBinaryExpression operator including AndAlso/OrElse, which are three-valued in SQL and do not propagate NULL, so DropNotNullChecks deletes a load-bearing IS NOT NULL guard. The query then returns true/false where it previously returned NULL, in both projections and WHERE row sets, with no error; Coalesce via ISqlExpressionFactory.MakeBinary has the same defect.
raw: #1 Critical: `NullPropagatedOperands` treats `AndAlso`/`OrElse` as null-propagating, so a load-bearing `IS NOT NULL` guard is dropped

claim: When clause.Result is a search condition (boolean predicate), collapsing the CASE removes the ELSE NULL arm that carried UNKNOWN into bool?. On SQL Server, SearchConditionConvertingExpressionVisitor later rewrites the predicate to CASE WHEN <pred> THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, which cannot produce NULL, so UNKNOWN silently becomes false and the returned row set changes in predicate contexts.
raw: #2 Critical: collapsing the `CASE` when the result is a search condition turns UNKNOWN into `false`
